ref: ADR-0025 Data errors name their box (F-19, Q10): a malformed date is err:FORG0001 in both back ends, naming the box; ADR-0003: parsing is strict, and SimpleDateFormat has no year 0000
note: sourceFormat yyyyMMdd: Sku in context Orders is 00000101. xs:dateTime has a year 0000 (XSD 1.1), SimpleDateFormat has none, so the run raises err:FORG0001 at N1 and writes nothing.
